links.title: Attention Is All You Need
links.summary: Seminal paper introducing the Transformer architecture.
links.description: This paper proposes the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and convolutions entirely, based solely on attention mechanisms. This work has fundamentally changed NLP and influenced computer vision.

links.title: Deep Learning Book
links.summary: Comprehensive textbook by Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, and Aaron Courville.
links.description: The definitive textbook on deep learning, covering mathematical foundations, modern practices, and research perspectives. Essential reading for any CV researcher.

links.title: PyTorch
links.summary: Open source machine learning framework for Python.
links.description: PyTorch is a Python package that provides tensor computation with strong GPU acceleration and deep neural networks built on a tape-based autograd system. Widely used in CV research.

links.title: ImageNet Dataset
links.summary: Large-scale visual recognition dataset with 14M+ images.
links.description: ImageNet is an image database organized according to the WordNet hierarchy. Each node of the hierarchy is depicted by hundreds and thousands of images. Crucial for CV benchmarking.

links.title: YOLOv8 by Ultralytics
links.summary: State-of-the-art real-time object detection model.
links.description: YOLOv8 is the latest version of the YOLO family, offering improved accuracy and speed for object detection, segmentation, and classification tasks.

links.title: Fei-Fei Li
links.summary: Professor at Stanford, co-director of Human-Centered AI Institute.
links.description: Dr. Fei-Fei Li is a pioneer in computer vision and AI. She created ImageNet and is a leading voice in ethical AI development and human-centered AI research.

links.title: MIT CSAIL
links.summary: MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory.
links.description: CSAIL is the largest research laboratory at MIT and one of the world's most important centers of information technology research. Strong focus on computer vision and robotics.

links.title: Stanford Vision Lab
links.summary: Leading computer vision research group at Stanford University.
links.description: The Stanford Vision Lab conducts research in computer vision, machine learning, and graphics. Home to many influential papers and datasets including ImageNet.

links.title: Carnegie Mellon University
links.summary: Top-tier university with renowned computer vision program.
links.description: CMU's Computer Vision Department is one of the oldest and most respected in the world. Strong industry connections and groundbreaking research output.

links.title: OpenAI
links.summary: AI research company focused on safe AGI development.
links.description: OpenAI conducts cutting-edge research in computer vision, including CLIP, DALL-E, and GPT-4 Vision. Known for open research and safety-focused approach.

links.title: Google DeepMind
links.summary: AI research lab combining Google Brain and DeepMind.
links.description: DeepMind produces influential CV research including AlphaFold, Perceiver, and Flamingo. Focus on general intelligence and scientific discovery.

links.title: COCO Dataset
links.summary: Common Objects in Context - image recognition dataset.
links.description: COCO is a large-scale object detection, segmentation, and captioning dataset. 330K images with 80 object categories and 5 captions per image.

links.title: OpenCV
links.summary: Open source computer vision and machine learning library.
links.description: OpenCV was designed for computational efficiency and strong focus on real-time applications. Written in C++ with interfaces for Python, Java, and more.

links.title: CS231n: CNN for Visual Recognition
links.summary: Stanford's famous computer vision course.
links.description: This course teaches the details of implementing and training neural networks for visual recognition. Includes lectures, assignments, and comprehensive notes.

links.title: Mask R-CNN
links.summary: Instance segmentation framework extending Faster R-CNN.
links.description: Mask R-CNN adds a branch for predicting segmentation masks on each Region of Interest, in parallel with existing branches for classification and bounding box regression.

links.title: Hugging Face
links.summary: Platform for sharing and discovering ML models and datasets.
links.description: Hugging Face hosts thousands of pre-trained computer vision models, datasets, and demos. Essential resource for practitioners and researchers.

links.title: NVIDIA Research
links.summary: NVIDIA's AI and computer vision research division.
links.description: NVIDIA Research produces cutting-edge work in generative AI, neural rendering, autonomous vehicles, and more. Strong industry-academia collaboration.

links.title: Legacy Vision Dataset
links.summary: This dataset is no longer maintained.
links.description: This project was deprecated in 2020. Please use COCO or ImageNet instead.

links.title: GAN Training Methods Patent
links.summary: US Patent for improved GAN training stability.
links.description: This patent covers novel techniques for stabilizing Generative Adversarial Network training, including gradient penalty and spectral normalization methods.

links.title: CVPR 2024 Best Paper
links.summary: Award-winning paper on neural scene representation.
links.description: This paper introduces a novel approach to neural scene representation that achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks while reducing computational cost.
